requirements.subject: user-agent
requirements.assertion: Under CSS Cascade Level 5, an important declaration in the earliest author layer takes precedence over important declarations in later layers and outside explicit layers.
requirements.rationale: The SVG 2 baseline requires CSS styling, and the 2022 CSS Cascade Level 5 Candidate Recommendation defines the layer ordering exercised here. This fixture records implementation of that later dependency. The hash covers normalized text from the listed support passages in order.

requirements.subject: user-agent
requirements.assertion: Under CSS Cascade Level 5, a normal declaration in the first author layer can override the corresponding SVG presentation attribute.
requirements.rationale: The SVG 2 baseline describes presentation attributes. This fixture exercises their interaction with author layers from the 2022 CSS Cascade Level 5 Candidate Recommendation. The hash covers normalized text from the listed support passages in order.
